sections.h2: Where does Jackson County keep its deed records?
sections.html:
The Jackson County Register works from Room 108 at 401 Grindstaff Cove Road in Sylva, NC 28779. The county's department page gives one weekday window for walk-in recording and e-recording alike, opening at 8 in the morning and closing at half past four.

Archives there cover real estate transactions, Jackson County births and deaths and marriage licenses issued locally. The office records DD214 military discharge forms and issues certified copies to veterans free of charge. Questions about recording go to 828-586-7530.

  • Records portal: deeds.jacksonnc.org
  • E-recording: the department page links an e-recording guide
  • Plat questions: Land Records and Mapping at 828-586-7539, or the Planning Department at 828-631-2261

Tax Administration shares the 401 Grindstaff Cove Road address, so one visit can cover both recording and the tax certification described below.

sections.h2: What format must a Jackson County deed follow?
sections.html:
Anything filed after July 1, 2002 has to satisfy G.S. 161-14(b), and the county spells the rules out on its recording requirements page. A document that misses them draws a $25 non-standard fee added to the usual recording charge.

  • Letter paper (8.5 by 11) or legal paper (8.5 by 14), with the original handed in
  • A three-inch blank band at the head of page one, and half an inch along its other edges and on every edge of later pages
  • Black ink on white stock, typeface of at least 10 points
  • Print on a single side
  • The name of the instrument printed beneath the top margin

The staff draft nothing, supply no forms and alter nothing on a submitted paper. If a legal description has an error, the drafter must correct it.

Land records review each deed too. The county asks for an individual's or law firm's name and address as preparer on the first page, the names and addresses of the grantors and grantees, either a metes and bounds description or a plat cabinet and slide reference, the grantor's back deed references, and a statement on whether any grantor lives on the parcel as a primary residence. A deed that divides a parcel must cite a recorded survey or bear approval from the Planning Department.

sections.h2: What are Jackson County's recording charges?
sections.html:
Ordinary instruments run $26 for the opening fifteen pages with $4 for each page past that, and a deed of trust is $64 for its opening thirty-five pages. The county prints these amounts, which agree with G.S. 161-10.

Charges posted by the Jackson County Register of Deeds
Item filed or requestedAmount
Deed, assignment, release or power of attorney, pages 1 to 15$26
Each page beyond the first set$4
Deed of trust, pages 1 to 35$64
SatisfactionNo charge
Plat, each page$21
Certified plat copy$5
Uncertified plat copy$2
UCC filing of two pages$38
UCC filing of three to ten pages$45
Document outside the format rules$25 added

Source: the Register of Deeds recording requirements and plats pages. A UCC termination is $38, and pages after the tenth add $2 apiece.

Payment method matters. Attorney or law firm checks, cashier's checks and money orders are taken. Personal checks are refused.

sections.h2: What does the deed excise tax look like in Jackson County?
sections.html:
The county prints the tax as $2 against every $1,000 of sales price, collected when a deed that conveys an interest is filed. That matches the statute's wording of $1 on each $500.

The excise tax statute says the seller pays the register ahead of filing. Half of the money stays with the county's general fund and half goes to the state. A parcel that straddles county lines is taxed by whichever county holds the larger value.

Jackson County adds a tax check that surprises some sellers. Since March 7, 2011, every deed goes to the Tax Collector's Office for a certification that no delinquent property taxes are owed, and the collector asks for the Parcel Identification Number to speed things up. If back taxes might exist on your parcel, ask for a payoff before the day of closing so the certification does not hold up recording.

sections.h2: How do property tax dates affect a Jackson County sale?
sections.html:
Tax Administration, at the same Sylva address, bills real and personal property for the county and also collects for Dillsboro, Forest Hills, Highlands and Webster. Sylva sends its own bill and keeps its own collections.

The county's 2026 calendar shows bills mailed July 20, a September 1 due date, and January 5, 2027 as the final day to pay without interest. Starting January 6, unpaid balances pick up 2 percent, then 0.75 percent more each month. The window to apply for relief programs closed June 1, 2026, and the formal appeal period for real property ran from March 23 to April 24, and the county's review board first met April 7.

Useful numbers for a seller: Tax Collections at 828-586-7550, Real Property at 828-586-7549, and Exemptions, Present-Use Value and Property Tax Relief at 828-586-7542. The county also notes that its land borders the Eastern Band of Cherokee Indians, so a parcel missing from county records may sit on tribal land, which the tribe maps through its own viewer. Because a tax lien reaches a parcel as of the listing date under G.S. 105-355, ask the collector to confirm any open balance in writing.

sections.h2: What are the rules for plats in Jackson County?
sections.html:
A plat sheet is accepted at 18 by 24 inches or 24 by 36 inches, with a border of at least half an inch on every side. The staff look for the surveyor's original seal and wet-ink signature plus the statements G.S. 47-30 requires.

Plats sent electronically face the same requirements as those carried in, and whoever submits is responsible for collecting signatures first. In-office plats must be reproducible, black on white paper or Mylar, and the county says paper copies were accepted starting March 1, 2025.

Some plats go to Land Records or the Planning Department for review before they are filed. If your lot came from a recent split, ask the surveyor whether the plat is already on file, since the deed has to cite it. The charge is $21 per page.

sections.h2: What does the Jackson County housing picture show?
sections.html:
Census QuickFacts lists 45,039 residents for mid-2025, a rise of 4.4 percent since April 2020. Land area is 491.11 square miles, so density averages roughly 88 residents on each one.

  • 28,707 housing units
  • Homeowners hold 60.8 percent of occupied homes (2020-2024)
  • Typical owner-held house value: $284,700
  • Middle monthly rent: $904
  • Household income at the median: $55,815
  • Residents aged 65 or more: 21.5 percent
  • Poverty rate: 16.9 percent

Sylva, Dillsboro, Forest Hills, Highlands and Webster each appear in the county's tax collection notes, and Cullowhee has its own community planning council on the county meeting calendar. A seller should confirm which town's rate applies to the parcel, since municipal bills are handled differently in Sylva than in the other towns.

The tourism side shows in the 2022 receipts: accommodation and food services brought in $1,038,484 thousand, well above total retail sales of $609,571 thousand.

faqs.q: Which Jackson County office accepts a deed for filing?
faqs.a: The Register of Deeds in Room 108 at 401 Grindstaff Cove Road, Sylva. Walk-in and electronic recording share one weekday window that closes at 4:30 p.m.

faqs.q: What is the Jackson County fee to file a deed?
faqs.a: Fifteen pages cost $26 and each added page costs $4, while a deed of trust starts at $64 for thirty-five pages. Paper outside the format rules adds $25.

faqs.q: Are personal checks accepted at the Jackson County recording desk?
faqs.a: No. Attorney or law firm checks, cashier's checks and money orders are the accepted payment types.

faqs.q: Does a Jackson County deed need a tax clearance?
faqs.a: Yes. Each deed goes to the Tax Collector's Office to certify there are no delinquent property taxes, so bring the parcel number.

faqs.q: How is excise tax figured on a Jackson County deed?
faqs.a: The county posts it as $2 per $1,000 of the sales price. The seller pays ahead of recording.
